scientific_integrity: The global cardinality claim has a self-contained parity/graph proof; exact example checker is supplementary. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three positive unbiased Bernoulli factors, pairwise irrational length ratios; no claim for rationally commensurate scales, biased masses or more than three factors. Literature priority remains provisional, especially finite-atomic Hadamard measure results and the unread remainder of the closest 2026 manuscript.
title: Odd-relation rigidity for orthogonal exponentials of three irrational Bernoulli factors
